c74object.name: mc.block~
c74object.digest: Block specified channels in a multichannel audio signal
c74object.description: The `mc.block~` object accepts a multichannel signal with an arbitrary number of channels in its first inlet. Its second inlet receives a list or integer of 1-based channel numbers to block. The object mirrors the incoming audio signal to its output on the first outlet, setting any specified blocked channels to zero (silent).

inlet.description: Accepts a multichannel audio signal containing an arbitrary number of channels.
Accepts a list or integer specifying 1-based channel numbers to block. Channels in this list will be set to zero at the output.

outlet.description: Outputs the mirrored multichannel signal with the specified channels set to zero.

objarg.name: blocked_channels
objarg.description: Optional initial 1-based channel numbers to block upon creation.

method.name: list
method.description: In the second inlet, sets the list of 1-based channel numbers to block.

method.name: int
method.description: In the second inlet, sets a single 1-based channel number to block.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears all blocked channels so that all channels pass through unblocked.
